h:
通过 ComfyUi 的这个工作流程，您可以修改男人和女人的不同风格的衣服。输入图像使用 MaskEditor 并等待全分辨率的输出图像。

用于示例的图像：

https://civitai.com/images/6340272

https://civitai.com/images/6373921

https://civitai.com/images/6389338

工作基于

  • 全分辨率修复

  • Text2img+Lora+Hires+ADx2+高档+风格滤镜

o.en:
With this workflow for ComfyUi you can modify clothes on man and woman with different style. Input image use MaskEditor and wait for output image at full resolution.

Images used for examples:

https://civitai.com/images/6340272

https://civitai.com/images/6373921

https://civitai.com/images/6389338

Work based on

  • Inpaint at Full Resolution

  • Text2img+Lora+Hires+ADx2+Upscale+Style filter
